# ScalableNeuromorphicArchitecture

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A hardware design approach that allows spiking neural networks to be expanded in size and complexity without proportional increases in energy or area overhead. Enables the integration of large-scale neural models into network infrastructure, a foundational requirement for practical iNEST deployments.
